data.gender_notes: Ashmita is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ashmita is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'asmita', meaning 'self-aware'. This name is often associated with the goddess Saraswati, who is the embodiment of wisdom and knowledge. In Hindu mythology, Ashmita represents the inner wisdom and intelligence that is present in all individuals. The name Ashmita carries the meaning “Wisdom, Intelligence” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ashmita usually hope their child will grow to embody wisdom, intelligence and live with faith, good character and purpose.
